title: House of Blue Light (Jerry Lee Lewis version)
lyrics_plain:
Well lace up your boots and we'll walk on down
To a knocked out shack on the edge of town
There's an eight beat combo that just won't quit
Keep a walkin' till you see a blue light lit
Fall in there and you'll dig some sights
Down at the house, the house of blue lights.
There's fryers, broilers, ah Detroit barbecued ribs
But the treat of the trade is when
they serve you all those fine eight beats
You'll wanna spend the rest of your brights
Down at the house, the house of blue lights
Yeah

serve you all those fine eight beats

Down at the house, the house of blue lights
